Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1380
Claimant:
Ashley Lewis
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
April 17, 2023
Claim opened after a side impact at a signalized intersection; the claimant reports a wrist fracture and has retained
counsel, so all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
May 11, 2023
Confirmed the driver is litsed on the policy and that coverage was active at the time of loss; no coverage questions
remain open at this stage.
June 22, 2023
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the collision and describes the
impact as a side-on hit from the other vehicle's path.
July 1, 2023
Reviewed scene photos and two independent witness statements; both describe the accident the same way the
claimant and the other driver have, with no conflicting details noted.
July 10, 2023
Vehicle inspection shows damage to the driver-side door and quarter panel that lines up with the reported point of
impact; no prior damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the appraiser's findings.
July 17, 2023
Claimant's account has stayed consistent across the recorded call, the written statement, and the follow-up interview
through counsel.
September 12, 2023
Medical records show a wrist fracture consistent in type and force with a side impact of this kind, and the physician's
notes support the mechanism described.
September 30, 2023
Records also show treatment for the same wrist area within the past two years; the attending physician indicates that
earlier condition contributes to some of the current complaints, and I am noting it for the file.
October 3, 2023
Treatment followed a typical course: immobilization, a follow-up procedure, then physical therapy, with the care
tapering as the claimant's range of motion improved.
October 22, 2023
Nothing in the file suggests damage predating the policy's effective date; the vehicle history and prior claims search
came back clean.
November 26, 2023
Sent the attorney the medical authorization forms and requested the complete treatment ledger, including the prior
wrist records, to finish the evaluation.
December 11, 2023
Current evaluation: the injury and vehicle damage fit the reported collision, and the open items are the final bills and
the prior-condition apportionment, which I will handle with the medical reviewer.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
